scenarios.title: Evidence revision, outcome evaluation and quarantined learning candidate
scenarios.purpose: Verify that experience and contradictory evidence revise provisional understanding, predictions remain immutable, and candidate learning is evaluated against a frozen baseline without silently changing active behaviour.
initial_state: An owner-authored objective and success criteria are immutable version 1 inputs.
The synthetic environment contains two related but non-identical contexts and one unrelated control context.
The baseline strategy, evaluation data IDs, scoring protocol and artifact digests are frozen before any candidate is generated.
No learning candidate is active; all candidate artifacts begin quarantined.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Monotonic virtual clock with fixed seed and explicit time advancement.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Deterministic model adapter with recorded seed, fixed model artifact and repeatable structured outputs; no network access.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Isolated memory, event and governance SQLite stores with transaction snapshots and crash injection.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Synthetic provider that records exact request digest, can return success/unknown/contradictory receipt and never touches external resources.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Test-only authority fixture that can deny or allow an exact digest; it cannot modify production policy or grant itself authority.

steps.trigger: Receive a synthetic owner observation with source, timestamp, scope and limitations.
expected_transitions: Append one immutable experience and linked evidence in one owning-store transaction.
durable_assertions: Source observation bytes and provenance remain unchanged after downstream processing.
Duplicate idempotency replay returns the stored receipt without duplicate experience, event or outbox rows.

steps.trigger: Create a modality-neutral representation from the recorded experience.
expected_transitions: Create a new representation revision linked to exact experience ID and revision.
durable_assertions: Representation provenance points to the exact source experience revision.
No source experience or evidence row is overwritten.

steps.trigger: Introduce a second independently sourced observation that conflicts with the current provisional belief.
expected_transitions: Append a belief revision with both supporting and contradictory evidence links.
Preserve the prior belief revision and its confidence.
durable_assertions: Contradiction remains queryable and is not silently collapsed into a single fact.
The belief revision records the scope and uncertainty of the conflict.

steps.trigger: Generate a prediction and evaluation criteria before any simulated interaction.
expected_transitions: Persist an immutable prediction with horizon, confidence and criteria.
durable_assertions: Prediction digest and criteria are frozen before the outcome is revealed.
Later evaluation cannot mutate the original prediction.

steps.trigger: Evaluate possible means using current context and evidence, without a task-to-action lookup.
expected_transitions: Append a context-scoped affordance hypothesis with evidence, preconditions and uncertainty.
durable_assertions: The affordance is a hypothesis, not a capability grant or permission.
No fixed objective-to-operation mapping is consulted as an authoritative answer.

steps.trigger: Propose an exact interaction and operation under the synthetic provider context.
expected_transitions: Persist a proposal bound to exact objective, target, means hypothesis, effects and authority context.
No provider effect occurs at proposal time.
durable_assertions: Proposal existence does not create approval or dispatch.
The operation request digest binds the exact proposal and current descriptor/policy versions.

steps.trigger: The test authority fixture allows the exact operation digest and the synthetic provider returns an accepted receipt.
expected_transitions: Record the provider receipt separately from independently observed outcome evidence.
Mark the effect unverified until observation.
durable_assertions: Receipt success alone does not set verified outcome status.
The exact operation digest and attempt identity are retained.

steps.trigger: Observe the simulated world independently after the provider receipt.
expected_transitions: Append an interaction outcome with observation evidence and unresolved effects.
durable_assertions: Observed effect evidence is distinct from provider receipt.
Attribution remains uncertain unless the evidence supports it.

steps.trigger: Evaluate the frozen prediction against the independently observed outcome.
expected_transitions: Append an evaluation linked to prediction revision, observation evidence and attribution limits.
durable_assertions: Original prediction remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
Evaluation cannot claim causal certainty beyond evidence.

steps.trigger: Propose an evidence-linked learning update and run a quarantined candidate experiment.
expected_transitions: Persist candidate lineage to experience, outcome, hypothesis, frozen baseline and evaluation protocol.
Candidate remains quarantined pending separate acceptance/activation authority.
durable_assertions: No active model, policy, strategy or capability state changes at proposal or experiment completion.
Experiment artifacts include code/data/model hashes, seed, environment and metrics.

steps.trigger: Evaluate the candidate on held-out related variations and unrelated controls.
expected_transitions: Record candidate metrics, regression checks, unseen controls and decision evidence.
durable_assertions: Candidate is rejected if held-out evidence is contaminated or incomplete.
No candidate activation is inferred; current registry lacks an accepted learning-update activation transition, which remains an explicit design blocker.

negative_controls.injection: Replay the same experience.submit idempotency key with a different payload digest.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Reject with key-reuse mismatch and preserve the original receipt and state.
must_not_change: Original experience/evidence rows
Original event/outbox count
Original receipt

negative_controls.injection: Attempt to use the provider receipt as the only outcome evidence.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Keep outcome unverified and refuse a verified-success claim.
must_not_change: Frozen prediction
Independent observation evidence requirement

negative_controls.injection: Attempt to activate the learning candidate without a canonical acceptance/activation transition and exact approval.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Keep candidate quarantined; no active pointer or behaviour changes.
must_not_change: Active model/strategy/policy version
Governance policy and permission state

restart_replay_controls: Crash after experience commit but before response; restart must replay the stored receipt without duplicating the event.
Crash after provider dispatch but before receipt persistence; recovery must reconcile before any retry.
Restart after candidate evaluation; baseline, candidate, dataset hashes and quarantine state must be identical.
concurrency_controls: Submit two belief revisions against the same expected revision; exactly one may commit and the other must receive a typed conflict.
Run two evaluations against the same frozen baseline; they must not mutate each other's candidate artifacts.
fault_controls: Inject storage commit uncertainty and prove no duplicate append.
Inject provider timeout after dispatch and prove no blind retry.
Inject worker timeout and prove candidate artifact remains quarantined and incomplete.
held_out_controls: Use related unseen environment variations not present in the candidate training set.
Use unrelated control objectives to detect broad regression.
Freeze data IDs and content hashes before candidate evaluation; reject train/test overlap.

acceptance_thresholds.learning_metric_rule: Pre-register the metric, minimum improvement, sample size and confidence procedure before evaluation; do not invent numeric thresholds in this planning fixture. Candidate must improve on held-out related variations and remain within predeclared unrelated-regression tolerance.
acceptance_thresholds.evidence_requirement: Record exact implementation commit, fixture hash, toolchain, runtime environment, seeds, durable-state snapshots, provider traces, artifact hashes and complete metrics.

scenarios.title: Open-world objective with unknown and changing means
scenarios.purpose: Verify objective-led reasoning across a changing synthetic world, including unknown entities, conflicting evidence, non-device/human-mediated means and newly discovered interfaces without a closed task/action catalogue.
initial_state: Owner objective is supplied independently of any device/provider list and includes explicit success evidence and constraints.
The initial situation contains one partially observed entity and one unresolved relationship.
The first context has no validated provider descriptor for a relevant means; unknown is not treated as unavailable or prohibited.
A second context is introduced later with a new schema-compatible descriptor and changed preconditions.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Monotonic virtual clock with controlled context-change points.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Deterministic inference adapter that returns hypotheses with explicit evidence references and uncertainty.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Isolated stores retaining objective revisions, observations, relationships, situation snapshots and plan dependencies.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Synthetic discovery adapters: one unknown interface, one schema-compatible newly introduced interface, and one human-mediated option represented as data.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Default-deny authority fixture; discovery and affordance evaluation never mutate permissions or approvals.

steps.trigger: Record owner intent and success criteria without selecting a means.
expected_transitions: Create owner objective revision 1 with source and constraints.
durable_assertions: Objective remains distinct from derived goal and plan.
No operation or capability is created by objective capture.

steps.trigger: Observe a partially known entity with provenance and bounded scope.
expected_transitions: Append provisional entity observation and evidence links.
durable_assertions: Unknown identity remains provisional.
Observation does not imply the entity is a resource or capability.

steps.trigger: Create a situation snapshot with unknowns and contradictory claims explicit.
expected_transitions: Create versioned situation linked to exact objective, entities, observations and evidence.
durable_assertions: Unknown and contradictory evidence remain explicit.
Context snapshot does not rewrite source evidence.

steps.trigger: Generate possible means from current evidence, including a non-device or human-mediated candidate.
expected_transitions: Append one or more context-scoped affordance hypotheses with preconditions and expected effects.
durable_assertions: Means candidates are evidence-backed hypotheses, not a fixed action list.
Human-mediated means can be represented without requiring a device descriptor.

steps.trigger: Attempt discovery against an interface whose schema/version is unknown.
expected_transitions: Record discovery as unknown or unsupported without manufacturing an invocation contract.
durable_assertions: Unknown interface remains unknown.
No permission request, approval or operation dispatch is generated by discovery alone.

steps.trigger: Change the world context and introduce a new compatible provider descriptor.
expected_transitions: Append new observation/context revision and invalidate dependent stale situation/plan assumptions.
durable_assertions: Old context and evidence remain available as history.
The same objective is retained; feasible means are recomputed from new evidence.

steps.trigger: Discover and verify the newly introduced descriptor through the generic contract path.
expected_transitions: Persist validated descriptor provenance, version, constraints and lifecycle state.
durable_assertions: No task-specific core branch or closed enum is added.
Descriptor validation remains separate from permission and owner authorization.

steps.trigger: Revise the plan against the new situation and exact descriptor version.
expected_transitions: Append plan revision bound to current objective, situation, evidence and descriptor versions.
durable_assertions: Stale prior plan cannot dispatch.
Objective success criteria remain unchanged.

steps.trigger: Inspect candidate route under default-deny authority.
expected_transitions: Return no grant unless a separately authorized decision exists.
durable_assertions: Discoverability and technical feasibility do not imply permission.
System may ask, wait, delegate or stop when no safe authorized means exists.

negative_controls.injection: Remove required provenance or provide an unsupported major descriptor version.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Reject validation or preserve unknown state; do not infer missing interface fields.
must_not_change: Objective revision
Permission/approval state
Provider dispatch count

negative_controls.injection: Hold objective constant while changing context and descriptor evidence, then replay the previous plan.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Reject stale plan dependencies and require re-evaluation.
must_not_change: Owner objective and success criteria
Historical situation/evidence snapshots

negative_controls.injection: Present a human-mediated means without a device capability descriptor.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Represent it as a possible means with explicit constraints; do not reject it solely for lacking a device provider.
must_not_change: Capability registry inventory
OS permission state

restart_replay_controls: Restart after observation and prove entity/situation provenance and unknowns persist.
Replay capability discovery result and prove no duplicate descriptor or permission grant.
Restart after context change and reject the stale plan revision.
concurrency_controls: Race a context revision against plan.revise; stale dependency must conflict or trigger explicit recomputation.
Race descriptor invalidation against capability verification; only the current descriptor epoch may be used.
fault_controls: Inject discovery timeout and retain unknown/attempt status without claiming absence.
Inject malformed provider schema and quarantine descriptor.
Inject storage failure during situation snapshot; no partial objective/entity relation commit.
held_out_controls: Introduce a novel entity type and schema-compatible provider not present in baseline fixtures.
Vary the same objective across physical, social and digital contexts without adding task-specific branches.
Include an environment with no safe available means; expected behaviour is to ask, wait, delegate or stop.

acceptance_thresholds.learning_metric_rule: No learning-improvement claim is made by this scenario; candidate means must be generated from the supplied evidence and context, and held-out environment variations must be processed through the same generic mechanisms.
acceptance_thresholds.evidence_requirement: Record objective/situation/descriptor revisions, unknown/conflict state, candidate means, plan dependency digests, permission query result and provider call trace.

scenarios.title: Exact-operation authority revocation and uncertain external effect
scenarios.purpose: Verify that proposal, authorization, provider dispatch, receipts, independent outcome observation and recovery remain separate under revocation, crash, duplicate delivery and uncertain side effects.
initial_state: A synthetic provider and exact target are seeded with a stable descriptor/version and reversible test effect.
OS permission and AURIONS policy are represented as separate authority inputs.
An approval fixture is bound to one exact operation digest, target, parameters, effects, risk and expiry.
Provider can commit an effect while dropping the response to create an uncertain receipt.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Virtual clock controls approval expiry, deadlines and cancellation races.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Deterministic planner proposes an exact operation but cannot create authority or mutate policy.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Separate isolated operation, event and governance stores with crash points before/after commit and dispatch.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Idempotent fake provider that can apply an effect then drop its receipt; exposes read-only reconciliation evidence.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Independent policy and OS-permission fakes; revocation and expiry are controlled separately.

steps.trigger: Create an interaction proposal bound to an exact objective, target, descriptor and effects.
expected_transitions: Persist proposal as non-dispatchable intent.
durable_assertions: Proposal cannot dispatch or create an approval by itself.
Proposal digest includes exact target, parameters and descriptor version.

steps.trigger: Request approval for the exact operation digest.
expected_transitions: Persist approval request with scope, risk, expiry and operation digest.
durable_assertions: Any change to target, data, parameters, effects or descriptor invalidates the approval binding.
Owner and actor identity come from authenticated context, not model text.

steps.trigger: Test authority fixture records an explicit allow decision while OS permission is independently present.
expected_transitions: Record a current approval and separate platform permission evidence.
durable_assertions: Governance approval and OS permission remain separate records.
Neither is inferred from provider discovery or model confidence.

steps.trigger: Dispatch the exact operation; provider applies the effect but drops the receipt.
expected_transitions: Persist attempt as dispatched/uncertain according to observed boundary; do not assume failure or success.
durable_assertions: One provider effect at most for the idempotency key.
Unknown side-effect state prohibits blind retry.

steps.trigger: Crash after provider effect and before receipt persistence, then restart runtime.
expected_transitions: Recover operation as uncertain and request fresh provider reconciliation evidence.
durable_assertions: No automatic redispatch occurs during restart.
Operation and attempt state remain distinct.

steps.trigger: Reconcile the uncertain attempt using read-only provider evidence.
expected_transitions: Advance only to a state supported by fresh provider evidence; retain uncertainty if evidence is absent or contradictory.
durable_assertions: Reconciliation does not execute the operation again.
Provider receipt/effect evidence is not confused with independent world observation.

steps.trigger: Revoke approval and remove OS permission after reconciliation.
expected_transitions: Append approval revocation; deny any future dispatch under the revoked grant.
durable_assertions: Revocation does not claim to reverse an already committed external effect.
A new operation requires a fresh permission and approval evaluation.

steps.trigger: Record independent postcondition evidence and evaluate the outcome.
expected_transitions: Append observed outcome and evidence with attribution uncertainty.
durable_assertions: Outcome status is based on independent observation, not only provider receipt.
No causal claim exceeds the evidence.

negative_controls.injection: Modify one parameter after approval and reuse the old approval.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Reject before dispatch because the operation digest no longer matches.
must_not_change: Provider call count
Approval scope
Operation terminal state

negative_controls.injection: Retry after a dispatched attempt whose receipt is unknown.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Require reconciliation; no second provider invocation.
must_not_change: Provider effect count
Original attempt receipt
Operation idempotency record

negative_controls.injection: Revoke approval while a second dispatch is queued.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Block the queued dispatch at the final authority boundary.
must_not_change: Historical committed effect
Revocation record
Operation attempt history

restart_replay_controls: Crash before local operation commit; restart must show no dispatched effect.
Crash after dispatch before receipt; restart must mark uncertain and reconcile before retry.
Replay approval revoke and operation reconcile messages; each state transition is applied at most once.
concurrency_controls: Race approval revocation with dispatch; final enforcement boundary must serialize/resolve so revoked authority cannot authorize a later dispatch.
Race two identical operation commands; only one external effect may occur and the duplicate receives the stored receipt/reconciliation result.
Race reconciliation with cancellation; preserve truthful pending/succeeded/uncertain state without claiming external reversal.
fault_controls: Provider applies effect and drops response.
Event/outbox commit becomes uncertain after operation state mutation.
Governance store unavailable at final authorization check; fail closed.
OS permission revoked between planning and dispatch.
held_out_controls: Use a second provider implementation with the same declared contract but different receipt timing.
Vary the operation target and parameter digest while retaining the original approval.
Test absent, expired and revoked OS permission independently from absent, expired and revoked AURIONS approval.

hard_invariants: Provider receipts treated as verified outcomes without independent evidence = 0.
Revoked/expired approvals used for future dispatch = 0.
acceptance_thresholds.learning_metric_rule: Not a learning scenario; no behavioural update is permitted from an uncertain or unverified effect.
acceptance_thresholds.evidence_requirement: Record exact operation/approval digests, authority decisions, OS permission evidence, provider call/effect trace, event/outbox state, restart snapshots and independent outcome evidence.

scenarios.title: CM-001 — immutable experience with independent representations
scenarios.purpose: One immutable experience with multiple independently versioned representations; source record unchanged.
initial_state: Prepare one owner-scoped experienceObserved payload with stable source identity, observed time, provenance, uncertainty and exact source revision.
Prepare two distinct representation requests with unique IDs and different representation types/method versions; both reference the same exact experience revision.
Record the source payload digest and authenticated owner/actor scope before any command is accepted.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Monotonic virtual clock with deterministic advancement.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Seeded deterministic inference adapter; no network or unrecorded model variation.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Isolated owner-scoped memory, event and governance stores with snapshot and fault injection.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Deterministic fake provider/observer appropriate to the scenario; no external resource is touched.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Independent default-deny authority and OS-permission fakes; no fixture can grant production authority.

steps.trigger: Initialize the owner-scoped source payload, two representation requests and fixed source digest.
expected_transitions: Seed the test inputs only; no experience or representation is committed.
durable_assertions: Owner/actor scope and source provenance are fixed; initial durable state contains no target experience or representation.

steps.trigger: Submit the source observation with provenance, observed time and explicit uncertainty.
expected_transitions: Append one immutable experience and its validated evidence links in the owning memory-store transaction.
durable_assertions: The source record is append-only; source content, provenance, observed time and uncertainty are retained exactly; the experience and evidence events are emitted once.

steps.trigger: Create representation R-A from the exact submitted experience ID and revision using method A.
expected_transitions: Create representation R-A at revision 1 with an exact source experience ID/revision reference.
durable_assertions: R-A is independently versioned and points to the exact immutable source revision; the source experience digest is unchanged.

steps.trigger: Create representation R-B from the same source revision using a different representation type or method version.
expected_transitions: Create representation R-B at revision 1 without mutating R-A or the source experience.
durable_assertions: R-A and R-B have distinct identities and independent revisions while retaining the same exact source lineage; the source digest remains unchanged.

steps.trigger: Read both representations and their source lineage by exact owner-scoped IDs.
expected_transitions: Return both immutable representation revisions and their source references without a write.
durable_assertions: The query returns exactly R-A and R-B with source revision lineage; owning rows, event/outbox counts and receipts remain unchanged.

steps.trigger: Attempt representation creation with a cross-owner source or stale source revision.
expected_transitions: Deny or return a typed stale-dependency conflict before committing any representation.
durable_assertions: No representation is appended; no source record, existing representation, event/outbox count or other owner state changes.

steps.trigger: Restart the isolated runtime and replay the accepted command receipts with their original idempotency identities.
expected_transitions: Recover the immutable source and both representations; return stored receipts without repeating committed effects.
durable_assertions: Both representations and the source survive restart; event/outbox counts remain unchanged after replay; no duplicate representation or source revision appears.

negative_controls.injection: Submit representation.create with either an experience owned by another principal or an obsolete source revision.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Return a scoped denial or DEPENDENCY_VERSION_STALE conflict; do not reveal cross-owner existence or create a representation.
must_not_change: Immutable source experience and evidence
Existing representation identities and revisions
Owner-scoped event/outbox counts and receipts

restart_replay_controls: Replay the same experience.submit key and digest; return its original receipt and do not append another experience/evidence pair.
Replay each representation.create key and digest; return the original representation receipt without another representation.created event.
Crash after a representation commit but before response; restart must return the stored receipt and preserve exactly one representation revision.
concurrency_controls: Race two representation.create requests with distinct IDs against the same immutable source revision; both may commit independently without changing the source.
Race duplicate representation IDs or a stale source revision; one identity cannot be committed twice and stale lineage must fail closed.
fault_controls: Fail the representation transaction before commit; no representation or representation.created event may survive.
Simulate uncertain commit after write; reconcile the receipt before retry and prohibit duplicate representation creation.
held_out_controls: Use an unseen but schema-compatible representation type/method version; the generic representation contract must accept or explicitly reject it based on schema/evidence, not a task-specific branch.
Use a second unrelated source experience as a control; its lineage and digest must remain unchanged.

hard_invariants: Duplicate durable or external effects after replay/recovery = 0.
Unknown or uncertain effects silently reported as success = 0.
acceptance_thresholds.learning_metric_rule: For learning-related scenarios, pre-register metric, minimum improvement, sample size and confidence procedure before evaluation; for other scenarios, make no learning-improvement claim.
acceptance_thresholds.evidence_requirement: Record exact implementation revision, fixture hash, toolchain, environment, seeds, durable-state snapshots, event/outbox counts, provider traces and negative-control results.

scenarios.title: CM-002 — context revision invalidates dependent reasoning
scenarios.purpose: Context revision invalidates dependent reasoning inputs; stale input is rejected or recomputed.
initial_state: Seed owner-scoped source records at fixed revisions and an authenticated actor; do not pre-create the context snapshot.
Prepare a reasoningAssessmentRequest that will bind to the context snapshot created by the first context.assemble command.
Capture source record revisions and digests so reassembly can be distinguished from source mutation.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Monotonic virtual clock with deterministic advancement.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Seeded deterministic inference adapter; no network or unrecorded model variation.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Isolated owner-scoped memory, event and governance stores with snapshot and fault injection.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Deterministic fake provider/observer appropriate to the scenario; no external resource is touched.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Independent default-deny authority and OS-permission fakes; no fixture can grant production authority.

steps.trigger: Initialize source records, fixed revisions and the dependent reasoning request.
expected_transitions: Seed only source records and request inputs; no context snapshot or reasoning assessment is committed.
durable_assertions: Source records and revisions are fixed; context and reasoning aggregates are initially absent.

steps.trigger: Assemble context snapshot C-001 from the exact source record revisions and assembly policy version.
expected_transitions: Create immutable context snapshot C-001 at revision 1 with explicit unknown and missing inputs.
durable_assertions: C-001 records every source ID/revision and the assembly policy version; source records remain unchanged.

steps.trigger: Create a reasoning assessment that references C-001 revision 1.
expected_transitions: Append an immutable reasoning assessment and hypothesis/evidence lineage bound to C-001 revision 1.
durable_assertions: The assessment records the exact context revision; a hypothesis remains a proposal, not a fact, plan, decision or action.

steps.trigger: Invalidate C-001 revision 1 after one dependent source revision changes or becomes stale.
expected_transitions: Mark the exact current context revision stale and advance the context head once; preserve all source records.
durable_assertions: The invalidation identifies C-001 revision 1; source evidence is not deleted and dependent reasoning inputs are no longer treated as current.

steps.trigger: Retry reasoning.assess using the stale C-001 revision 1 request.
expected_transitions: Reject with DEPENDENCY_VERSION_STALE or an equivalent typed stale-input result; append no new assessment or hypothesis.
durable_assertions: No reasoning.hypothesis.proposed event or new assessment is committed for stale context; prior assessment and source revisions remain intact.

steps.trigger: Reassemble context C-002 from the current source revisions.
expected_transitions: Create a new immutable context snapshot with a new revision and exact current source lineage.
durable_assertions: C-002 is distinct from C-001; the stale snapshot remains historical and source records are not rewritten.

steps.trigger: Re-run reasoning.assess using C-002 and its exact current dependency revisions.
expected_transitions: Append a new reasoning assessment bound to C-002; do not reuse the stale C-001 assessment as current.
durable_assertions: The new assessment records C-002's revision and dependencies; prior assessment history remains retrievable.

steps.trigger: Read the current context by owner-scoped ID and verify the prior snapshot's stale status.
expected_transitions: Return the current immutable snapshot and its exact dependency revisions without reassembly or mutation.
durable_assertions: C-002 is current; C-001 remains stale/history; the query leaves context, reasoning, event/outbox and receipt state unchanged.

steps.trigger: Restart and replay the accepted context and reasoning command receipts.
expected_transitions: Recover both context snapshots and assessments; do not promote stale C-001 or duplicate accepted events.
durable_assertions: Current/stale revision status survives restart; replay creates no additional context or reasoning events.

negative_controls.injection: Submit reasoning.assess with a dependency digest or context revision that no longer matches the current context head.
negative_controls.expected_disposition: Reject with DEPENDENCY_VERSION_STALE; do not silently reassemble or accept the stale reasoning input.
must_not_change: Source records and their revisions
Prior context snapshots and reasoning assessments
Current context head and event/outbox counts

restart_replay_controls: Replay context.assemble and reasoning.assess with the same scoped keys/digests; return stored receipts without new events.
After restart, C-001 remains stale and C-002 remains the current snapshot; do not infer freshness from creation time alone.
concurrency_controls: Race context.invalidate against reasoning.assess using the same expected context revision; serialize the owner transition so stale reasoning cannot commit after invalidation.
Race two context.assemble requests against changed source revisions; each snapshot must bind to one exact dependency set.
fault_controls: Fail context invalidation before commit; the old context remains current and no invalidation event is appended.
Simulate uncertain commit after invalidation; reconcile its receipt before reasoning can proceed.
held_out_controls: Change one source revision while preserving all other inputs; only dependent context and reasoning inputs become stale.
Add an unknown optional source attribute; context assembly must preserve it as unknown/unsupported rather than fabricate a value.

hard_invariants: Duplicate durable or external effects after replay/recovery = 0.
Unknown or uncertain effects silently reported as success = 0.
acceptance_thresholds.learning_metric_rule: For learning-related scenarios, pre-register metric, minimum improvement, sample size and confidence procedure before evaluation; for other scenarios, make no learning-improvement claim.
acceptance_thresholds.evidence_requirement: Record exact implementation revision, fixture hash, toolchain, environment, seeds, durable-state snapshots, event/outbox counts, provider traces and negative-control results.

scenarios.title: CM-003 — contradictory evidence creates a new belief revision
scenarios.purpose: Contradictory evidence creates a new revision; prior evidence and revisions remain retrievable.
initial_state: Seed one owner-scoped belief B-001 at revision 1 with supporting evidence E-A and a fixed provenance chain.
Prepare a new contradictory observation E-B with independent source/time/provenance; do not alter E-A or B-001 revision 1.
Capture the current belief revision and evidence digests before submitting the new observation.

deterministic_fakes.clock: Monotonic virtual clock with deterministic advancement.
deterministic_fakes.inference: Seeded deterministic inference adapter; no network or unrecorded model variation.
deterministic_fakes.stores: Isolated owner-scoped memory, event and governance stores with snapshot and fault injection.
deterministic_fakes.provider: Deterministic fake provider/observer appropriate to the scenario; no external resource is touched.
deterministic_fakes.authority: Independent default-deny authority and OS-permission fakes; no fixture can grant production authority.

steps.trigger: Initialize B-001 revision 1, its supporting evidence E-A and the independent contradictory observation payload E-B.
expected_transitions: Seed the existing belief and evidence only; do not mutate the belief head or append E-B.
durable_assertions: B-001 revision 1 and E-A are immutable and retrievable; E-B has a distinct source identity and provenance.

steps.trigger: Submit contradictory observation E-B as a new immutable experience/evidence record.
expected_transitions: Append E-B and its evidence link without overwriting or deleting E-A.
durable_assertions: E-B retains its own source, observed time, provenance and uncertainty; E-A and B-001 revision 1 remain unchanged.

steps.trigger: Revise B-001 using expected revision 1 and explicit links to both supporting E-A and contradicting E-B.
expected_transitions: Append belief revision 2 with both supporting and contradicting evidence lineage; preserve revision 1.
durable_assertions: The belief head advances once; prior claim, confidence, rationale and evidence links remain auditable; contradiction is not silently discarded.

steps.trigger: Read B-001 and its revision/evidence history by exact owner-scoped ID.
expected_transitions: Return both revision 1 and revision 2 with supporting and contradicting evidence references.
durable_assertions: The query exposes contradiction lineage and prior history without promoting, revising or deleting the belief.

steps.trigger: Attempt another belief.revise using stale expected revision 1 after revision 2 is current.
expected_transitions: Reject with EXPECTED_REVISION_CONFLICT; append no revision 3 and emit no belief.revised event.
durable_assertions: Belief head remains revision 2; evidence and prior revisions are unchanged; no additional event/outbox row is appended.

steps.trigger: Restart and replay the accepted experience.submit and belief.revise receipts.
expected_transitions: Recover E-A, E-B and both belief revisions; return stored receipts without duplicate appends.
durable_assertions: Both evidence records and the full belief revision history survive restart; replay creates no duplicate evidence or belief event.
